<action type="say">
I can help you get a plumber out.

First, a couple of quick questions so I can find someone and book them:

1) What’s the service address or at least your ZIP code?
2) How urgent is it: water actively leaking right now (emergency, need someone within a few hours) or can it wait until later today?
3) Any time constraints (e.g., “anytime today,” “after 5pm,” etc.)?
4) Do you care about anything specific in the plumber (e.g., minimum 4.5★ rating, lowest cost, or longest in business)?

Also, if water is still leaking and you can safely do so, turn off the shutoff valves under the sink (or the main water valve for the house) and put a bucket/towels under the leak to limit damage while we set this up.</action>
